scope: SSVEP blind spectral descriptors and18-channel covariance baselines; no new fitted peak, FOOOF or aperiodic parameter analysis
input: data_basic, each independent4-second1200x18 record, fs300, original reference and native units
extra_time_domain_processing: channel-wise mean removal only; no ICA, additional filters, record concatenation or trial/session pooling

covariance.shrinkage: scikit-learn OAS formula, vectorized per record; coefficient checked against sklearn.covariance.oas
covariance.eigenvalue_floor: 1e-8*trace(C)/18, only for positive definiteness and logarithms; clipping tracked
covariance.correlation: Pearson from empirical covariance before OAS, not shrunken covariance; constant channels flagged and correlations set0
covariance.trace_normalization: divide covariance by its trace, removing global gain but not all channel-specific scaling effects
covariance.matrix_log: natural matrix logarithm via eigen decomposition, not elementwise log; symmetric upper triangle, off-diagonals multiplied sqrt2
covariance.interpretation: mixed-signal second-order statistics; not pure periodicity, source connectivity or causal brain networks; OAS iid/Gaussian theory not guaranteed for temporally correlated EEG

blind_spectrum.psd: unchanged V1 Welch2s periodic Hann, 50% overlap, mean, nfft600, density, 0.5Hz grid; no smoothing or background removal
blind_spectrum.fixed_power_bins_hz: [4,5], [5,6], ..., [39,40], integrated linear PSD; shared trapezoid endpoints
blind_spectrum.shape: each1Hz bin divided by same-record same-channel4-40Hz integral, no log
blind_spectrum.local_contrast_centers_hz: 6,7,...,35; log10 power[f-0.5,f+0.5] minus log10 mean(power[f-2.5,f-1.5], power[f+1.5,f+2.5])
blind_spectrum.interpretation: blind frequency descriptors only; no winning frequency, stimulus frequency truth, target label, physiological response significance or known-f0 SNR claimed

validation: reuse V2 exact28 cases: filename-block same-session development, equal20 training records per identity, balanced cross-task diagnostic
classifier: same training-only median imputation, StandardScaler and uniform-prior shrinkage LDA; fixed parameters
task_comparisons: all four task labels used only for stratified diagnostics; blind features have identical fixed definitions for every record
test_policy: optional deterministic single-record feature extraction only; no test labels, dataset-level adaptation or parameter selection
